mLocKeys.keySummary: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, dealing damage and knocking them back.  If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fires a bolt that deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and knocks the enemy back. Enemies that collide with terrain take <physicalDamage>@TotalDamagewithSpell@ additional physical damage</physicalDamage> and are <status>Stunned</status> for 1.5 seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Judged</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is flying backward after being struck by one of Vayne's heavy crossbow bolts. It will be stunned if it collides with terrain.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers. She gains 30 Movement Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers. She gains <speed>30 Movement Speed</speed> when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot.  Her next attack deals bonus damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Rolls a short distance. The next basic attack within @BuffDuration@ seconds deals <physicalDamage>@ScalingDamageTotal@ bonus physical damage</physicalDamage>.
Vayne deals increased damage with her next basic attack.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Inquisition</titleLeft><mainText>Vayne is unleashing retribution on her foes.  She gains Attack Damage, improves the effect of Night Hunter, and gains invisibility after using Tumble.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, invisibility during Tumble, and triple the bonus Movement Speed from Night Hunter.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Gains <physicalDamage>@ADMod@ Bonus Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for @Duration@ seconds. While active, Tumble grants <keywordStealth>Invisibility</keywordStealth> for 1 second, and <spellName>Night Hunter's</spellName> bonus <speed>Movement Speed</speed> is increased to 90.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things.  The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's maximum Health as bonus true damage. (Max: 200 damage vs. Monsters)
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Every third consecutive attack or ability against an enemy deals an additional @BaseDamage@ plus @MaxHealthRatio*100@% of the enemy's maximum Health <trueDamage>true damage</trueDamage>. (Max: 200 damage vs. Monsters)
